proposals.before: He was then transferred to prefect of Ba and Ping.
proposals.after: He was then transferred to prefect of Badong and Jianping.
proposals.reason: Chinese 巴東、建平 are Badong and Jianping; 'Ba and Ping' drops syllables and confuses the place names.

proposals.before: He went out bearer of staff, commander of Liang and Qin military affairs, campaign general who subdues barbarians, and inspector of Nan and Liang.
proposals.after: He went out bearer of staff, commander of Liang and Qin military affairs, campaign general who subdues barbarians, and inspector of Nan Qin and Liang.
proposals.reason: Chinese 南秦梁二州 is Nan Qin and Liang; omitting Qin reverses the jurisdiction.

proposals.before: Xianpin was recalled for the failure and made cloud-cavalry general.
proposals.after: Xianpin was held responsible, recalled, and made cloud-cavalry general.
proposals.reason: 'Sat out the blame' / vague phrasing; 坐 marks being held liable for the defeat.

proposals.before: The next year Gaozu received the abdication; Qi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Anchang county in Qi with a fief of five hundred households, and remained Pacification North General and Administrator of Liyang.
proposals.after: The next year Gaozu received the abdication; Qi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Anchang county with a fief of five hundred households, and remained Pacification North General and Administrator of Liyang.
proposals.reason: Chinese 安昌縣侯 has no 'in Qi'; the literal invents a place qualifier from the personal name Qi.

decisions.reason: s0014 巴東、建平二郡太守 names the commanderies Badong and Jianping; “Ba and Ping” truncates both place names, and the proposed idiomatic restores them.
s0039 南秦梁二州刺史 is inspector of the two provinces Nan Qin and Liang; the before’s “Nan and Liang” drops 秦 and misstates the jurisdiction, while the proposed idiomatic restores it.
s0084 坐徵還 already supports the idiomatic “recalled for the failure,” which conveys liability for the prior defeat; “held responsible, recalled” is only a stylistic rewording, not a needed correction.
s0113 封齊安昌縣侯 enfeoffs the person 齊 as Marquis of Anchang county; “in Qi” is an invented place qualifier from his name, and removing it matches the Chinese.
